title: Philadelphia Experiment actually happened in Rhode Island
summary: Steven Greer tells of Philadelphia Experiment actually happened in Rhode Island, about 1942-1943 at Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

related.note: Both are about the Philadelphia Experiment. This telling says it really happened in Rhode Island and Philadelphia was the cover story, while the story calls the Philadelphia-to-Norfolk teleportation a bogus disinformation campaign.

Both explain what the Philadelphia Experiment really covered up. Greer says it was a cover for something done in Rhode Island; this telling says it hid a turbine explosion that showered the crew with radioactive hexafluoride.

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for UFO disclosure, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about the Philadelphia Experiment, a story that the US Navy made a warship vanish around 1943. Citing a man named Bob Beckwith, Greer says the experiment really happened in Rhode Island and that Philadelphia was only the cover story. If true, it would mean the Navy hid where its strangest wartime test took place.
